'''Contispex II''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] who was the [[Contispex dynasty|son]] of Supreme Chancellor [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]]. In [[11,947 BBY]], fanatics of the [[Pius Dea]] faith effectively had control over the Republic, and Contispex I stepped down as Chancellor, allowing Contispex II to rise to the position.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Contispex II was mentioned in the [[2012]] book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGW" />
